title: Ancient GPS Spellbook
description: A worn, leather-bound book with cracked blue and brown covers lies diagonally on a dark surface. A modern glowing green digital map screen is embedded in its center, displaying a world map with yellow route lines, glowing dots, and the text 'YOU ARE HERE' with a red marker over Europe.
prompt: A highly detailed magical ancient leather-bound book with cracked blue and brown covers, embedded with a glowing green digital world map screen showing yellow travel routes and a red marker labeled YOU ARE HERE over Europe, antique metal compass attached by chain, various stickers and pins on the cover, dark mystical atmosphere, dramatic lighting, intricate textures
